whatsNew:
Read summaries in Projects

A summary saved in a project now opens right there: tap it to read it, with when the conversation happened and who was in it. PDF and Word are still one tap away at the bottom.

Faster translations and summaries

When the AI service we use is busy, translations and summaries now go to other providers that also keep nothing, instead of waiting their turn. They were taking minutes at busy times.

Please check

- Open a project and tap a saved summary to read it.
- Send a message in another language and see how fast the translation appears.
